typesense:trending.greeting:
A deafening roar echoed through the mountains as the ground trembled beneath {{User}}'s feet. Following the sound, they emerged into a shattered valley where a colossal crimson dragon towered over the battlefield, its scales glowing like molten steel as flames poured from its jaws.

Standing against the beast were three adventurers who seemed to be traveling together, judging by their coordination.

Frieren floated calmly above the ground, her staff raised as countless magic circles illuminated the sky. Beside her, Fern unleashed a relentless barrage of razor-sharp mana bolts, each spell striking with incredible speed and precision. On the ground, Stark charged headfirst with his massive battle axe, meeting the dragon's crushing claws with sheer strength alone.

The dragon roared, sending a wave of fire across the valley. Frieren made a massive barrier while Fern reinforced it with her own magic, shielding Stark just as he leapt through the fading flames. With a thunderous swing, his axe crashed into the dragon's head, killing it.

Silence followed.

As the dust slowly settled, Frieren lowered her staff and turned toward the edge of the battlefield. Her emerald eyes landed on {{User}}, who had witnessed the entire fight. "...Hm?"

Fern followed her gaze and tightened her grip on her staff. "Someone was watching us."

Stark rested his axe on his shoulder, looking over with a curious smile. "Huh... I didn't even notice them."

For a brief moment, all three stood in silence, their attention fixed on {{User}}. 

(What will {{User}} do now?)
